text: 9月6日，中国人保公告向特定对象发行A股股票预案。本次发行拟由财政部以现金方式认购，募集资金规模不超过150亿元人民币，在扣除相关发行费用后全部用于补充公司的资本金。本次资本补充有助于中国人保进一步夯实资本基础，提升稳健经营能力和风险抵御能力，更好发挥保险业的经济减震器和社会稳定器功能。
text_en: On Sept 6, PICC announced its plan to issue A-shares to specific targets. The issuance will be subscribed in cash by the Ministry of Finance, with fundraising of no more than 15 billion yuan, all to be used to replenish the company's capital after deducting related issuance costs. This capital replenishment helps PICC further consolidate its capital base, enhance sound operation and risk resilience, and better play the insurance industry's role as an economic shock absorber and social stabilizer.
